title: File:Retro Game Camp Satellite Store Entrance.jpg
desc: The entrance of Retro Game Camp's satellite store in Akihabara near Excelsior Caffe, which was opened this year. This one is located underground and one needs to enter via staircase that goes to the basement level.

title: File:Retro gaming shop in Akihabara, Japan.jpg
desc: Millions of vintage systems. Closest to the front: famicom, Famicom disk system, Super Famicom. The systems got much weirder towards the back.
